visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with an older male host wearing a grey jacket and a blue beanie standing in front of a group of university students dressed in black and orange graduation gowns. They are in an outdoor setting with tall, brownish-green trees and a body of water in the background. The host gestures towards the group while speaking, and several male students smile and nod. (2) The host takes a small folded fan and playfully strikes the head of a male student in a graduation gown as if performing a blessing ceremony. A circular graphic overlay appears around the student's face. The host continues to walk down the line, repeating this action with several other students who bow their heads slightly to receive the "blessing." (3) The host moves to another location on the path and interviews a young man and woman, both in graduation gowns. The man is wearing glasses and the woman has long dark hair. Heart-shaped emojis and pink graphics appear on the screen during their interaction. (4) The host stands alone or with a smaller group, gesturing towards the camera and laughing. A black and white filter is applied to a shot of a student's face to emphasize a humorous or sad moment, followed by a close-up of the host's face as he continues his energetic monologue.

(2) A sharp 'whack' or 'thud' sound effect triggers every time the host hits a student with his fan, accompanied by 'whoosh' and 'ding' sound effects common in variety shows. (3) The audio shifts to a slightly more sentimental but still comedic tone with 'pop' sounds when the heart emojis appear. The host's speech speed remains high.
